description: Passage des piétons sur le littoral générateur de servitudes EL9 dans la Manche is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. Class EL9 easements relate to coastal easements designed to ensure pedestrian crossing along the coast and to provide them with free access to the coast. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian crossing on the EL9 easement-generating coastline in the Channel" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include limite du rivage, données ouvertes, passage littoral, sentier piétonnier, domaine public maritime, accès piéton. The listing shows 2021-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
